mentions.note: junior; won 200m (A) and 75mH (A) at Bournemouth, and 100 yds, 200m and LJ (A) in the Dorking Ladies Trophy

won Junior Ladies 200m, Middlesex Championships; won Junior Girls 75mH in a Championship Best Performance, London Schools; 25.78 senior club record in Junior Ladies 200m heats, Womens AAA Championships
